📦 **sirius-communion `20f66a4`** — feat(food): identify service meals and add communion icon

Track actual food portions by service recipe, apportion capped consumption deterministically, and retain credited menu portions in town summaries. Send separate service meal names/icons to Blockside; mass uses 聖餐. Keep legacy aggregate portions labelled without guessing names. Economics and total food credits unchanged.

ArtGallery 1d78f43 exhibited the white master and128px/32px previews before game import. Blockside609989f renders service rows; battle.html rebuilt. Dish checker now includes service menus, and missing mass.png is detected. Two existing home-meat dishes added to table as missing art.

Validated actual communion, shortage/prayer, capped same-grade and mixed-grade meals, multiple-menu rendering, escaped names, legacy summaries and townInfo serialization. Full365-day bld_jobs and class checks pass. Browser fixture uses actual town fed data and production renderer, not full WebGL town.

Refs TASK-1000

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
